items.title: SK Hynix’s U.S. Listing Didn’t Fix Its Micron Discount. Now It Has a New Plan.
items.summary: The South Korean company’s plan to repurchase and cancel shares could ease fears about the AI spending boom fizzling out.

items.title: Micron Gained Memory Market Share. The Stock Is Dropping Anyway.
items.summary: Micron Technology  stock was falling Wednesday after a sharp drop in the previous session.  Micron shares were down 0.6% in early trading.  In fact, the combined revenue of the top five publicly listed NAND flash-memory brands rose 77% in the second quarter from the previous quarter, to $68.87 billion, according to research firm Trendforce in data published Wednesday.

items.title: SanDisk Is Up 3,911% Over Twelve Months. Hedge Funds Can’t Agree on What to Do.
items.summary: SanDisk just posted one of the most violent stock runs in large-cap history, yet institutional investors are betting against each other in the options market with unusual aggression. The bull and bear cases point to very different versions of the same company.

items.title: This Brilliant Tech Investor Just Bought SpaceX, Micron, Cerebras and Some Other Semiconductor Names
items.summary: Brad Gerstner just placed some of his biggest bets of the year during one of the choppiest quarters for tech stocks, and his picks reveal exactly where Altimeter Capital thinks the AI trade heads next.

items.title: SK Hynix Rises 6% on $29B Buyback, SanDisk Gains 5%, Micron Climbs 3% as Memory Names Rebound
items.summary: SK Hynix just approved the largest treasury share cancellation in South Korean stock market history, and the move is pulling the entire memory sector off its lows. The real question is whether record capital returns and record fab spending can coexist without one of them breaking.

items.title: Moderna, Merck, SK Hynix, Micron, Target, Estée Lauder, and More Stocks That Explain Today’s Market
items.summary: Stocks were rising Wednesday as investors awaited minutes from the Federal Open Market Committee’s most recent monetary policy meeting.  Moderna  surged 88% and  Merck  advanced 6.7% after the two companies said a customized vaccine kept patients cancer-free for longer than standard treatments after melanoma skin cancers had been cut out.  SK Hynix  rose 5.3%.
